_comment: Copy this file to overlay/<tiktok_video_id>.json to enable overlay mode for that clip.
_when_to_use: Tool demos, workflow walkthroughs, website teardowns, resource clips, before/after proof. Only when screen proof exists or proof_asset is provided.
_banner_guidance: 5-8 words max. Proof-first hook. Examples: 'I built this in 20 minutes', 'Free tool most people ignore', 'This replaced my entire workflow'
_proof_asset_note: Optional. Absolute path to a screen recording (.mp4) or screenshot (.jpg/.png) to use as the full-frame background. If null, banner is applied to the normalized video as-is.
_pip_scale_note: Chris PIP size relative to frame. 0.35 = 35% of frame dimensions. Range: 0.15–0.6.
